commit_message: Add Project Rust VFX gameplay control
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 first-release VFX scope
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining ADR 0125 first-release requirements on the current-main baseline. This initial slice adds the formal Project Rust deferred-command and copied-view boundary for scene VFX players without exposing ECS internals. Additional authoring, preview, Problems, performance, and visual-validation slices follow on the same Draft PR.

## Safety

- additive Project Rust command/view variants only
- existing VFX serialization and stable IDs remain unchanged
- no direct ECS access is exposed to project code
- no out-of-scope GPU simulation, collision events, sub-emitters, ribbon renderer, soft particles, or vector fields
